references.text: Prohibits sacrificing children to Moloch, which is the same practice as making children pass through fire
Prohibits divination and augury, the same prohibition against occult practices
Prohibits seeking out mediums and spiritists, a parallel prohibition against occult practices
God's judgment on those who turn to mediums and spiritists
The death penalty for mediums and spiritists, showing the seriousness of these sins
King Ahaz made his son pass through fire, an example of this forbidden practice
Israel made their children pass through fire and practiced divination and augury
King Manasseh made his son pass through fire and practiced sorcery and divination
Judgment on false prophets who practice divination and deliver deceptive visions
The Lord will eradicate sorcery from the people
Simon the sorcerer in Samaria, an example of forbidden magical practices
Believers in Ephesus burned their magic books after converting
Sorcery is listed among the deeds of the flesh that prevent inheritance in God's kingdom
